title: Cumulative Selection Explorer
role: Compare cumulative selection with random change and see how repeated choice reshapes outcomes.
description: A classic selection demo reframed as a tool for exploring variation, selection, and the limits of simple models.

api.notes: A shared browser and node-consumable API module now exists for the artificial-life remediation family.

tests.notes: A node-based contract test suite now exercises the shared artificial-life family API module.

provenance.summary: Public evo-edu framing over the legacy Weasel demonstration.
provenance.details: Cumulative Selection Explorer is the evo-edu public route for the Weasel-style cumulative-selection model family. The remediation pass now includes a direct responsive workbench using the shared artificial-life API while preserving the older Weasel route as a legacy reference.
lineage: Public evo-edu route: Cumulative Selection Explorer
limits: The new public workbench uses the shared artificial-life API rather than the older embedded route.
The older Weasel-style route remains available as a legacy reference.
The tool is useful for model critique, but it does not by itself represent the full complexity of biological evolution.
